texts.preamble: Mr.Lloyd Joseph Sequeira vs Mrs.Louella Sequeira @ Louella on 13 June, 2016 Title Sheet In The Court Of The Lvii Addl.City Civil & Sessions Judge: Mayo Hall Unit: Bangalore (Cch- (Cch-58) Dated this the 13th day of June 2016. Present: Present Smt.B.S.Rekha, B.A.,(Law) Ll.M. Lvii Addl. City Civil & Sessions Judge, City Civil Court, Mayohall Unit, Bangalore. Case No: Crl.A.25164 Crl.A.25164/201 164/2014 /2014 Parties Name: Appellant : Mr.Lloyd Joseph Sequeira S/o late Michael Sequeira Aged about 56 years, Resident of No.26, Chico Square, Square, st th 1 floor, 5 cross, Hutchins road, Bangalore- Bangalore-560 084 084. 84. (By Sri.A.M.Vijay -Advocate)
texts.facts: This appeal is filed by the appellant against the Judgment passed by the learned Metropolitan Magistrate, MMTC-I, Mayo Hall unit, Bangalore in Crl.Misc.No.723/2010, dated 17.9.2014. 2. The contention of the appellant is that the impugned order is opposed to facts and law. There is no convincing evidence or materials placed by the respondent to implicate the appellant for having allegedly committed domestic violence against the respondent. The amount awarded by the trial court on various heads is unjustifiable. The trial court failed to appreciate the fact that it is not the case of the respondent that she and her daughters were depending upon the appellant for their livelihood. The evidence of the respondent clearly shows that she had the capacity of earning. It is contended that the appellant has no source of income and continues to be unemployed since the time he returned from Middle East in 2000. The evidence discloses that the respondent and her daughters have been leading comfortable live. The trial court has committed an error in not appreciating the admissions made by PW.3 that the respondent is maintaining the family from out of the fixed deposits kept in her name by the appellant. 3. The facts of the complaint are that the respondent is the husband of the aggrieved person having married on 118.1.1987 at Bangalore as per the Christian Religion rights and customs. The aggrieved person has two female children who are majors at present. Since last two 4 Cr.A.25164/2014 years, the respondent is causing domestic violence and he threatened them that he will destroy the original documents of the immoveable property. The respondent is residing separately from the aggrieved person since 19.7.2010. The aggrieved person was earlier working in Infosys, Wipro, Phoenix Global, NIIT, Mphasis as Communication Consultant. The house property was purchased by her and the respondent in joint names. She apprehends transfer of the property in the name of the respondent. Mr.Lloyd Joseph Sequeira vs Mrs.Louella Sequeira @ Louella on 13 June, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153314617/ 2 Hence, the complaint. 4. The respondent filed objections admitting the marital relationship but denied the allegation of domestic violence. He has further contended that earlier he was living in Muscat and from 2000 he started living in Bangalore. He has acquired the property from his hard earned money in the joint name of himself and the aggrieved person. The aggrieved person was a housewife from 1987 to 2000 and worked only from 2000 to 2007 in Bangalore as they wanted to settle in Bangalore. The 5 Cr.A.25164/2014 attitude of the aggrieved person changed when he stopped working in 2000 and she became hostile towards him. 4. Based on the evidence and the materials available on record the learned Magistrate has passed the impugned order. According to her throughout the marriage she suffered and the respondent traumatized her for unnecessary reasons and he had no regards for safety or health. He habitually misconducted himself and he used to insult her. He used to hang the pet dogs outside the bedroom window. He locked her and her children in the house and he threatened with life. On 25.9.2010 the respondent threatened that he would destroy the original documents of the immoveable property. She filed complaint. From 16.7.2010 he lived separately in a house near the matrimonial house where they Mr.Lloyd Joseph Sequeira vs Mrs.Louella Sequeira @ Louella on 13 June, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153314617/ 3 were residing previously. The respondent used to abuse the guests of the Petitioner. He used to accuse her of having extra marital affair. She had stated about the properties. When she was working, the respondent had sent many defamatory e-mails. He used to lock her cloths and work materials and prevented her from going to work. He used 7 Cr.A.25164/2014 to cause disturbance by cutting off the water supply, internet and phone facilities. She relied upon Ex.P.1 to P.5. 9. During the course of cross-examination she has stated that it was an arranged marriage. At the time of marriage, the respondent was working in Muscat in Bank of Oman and Baharain and Kuwait as Credit Officer. Thereafter he worked in Oman in different firms. In the year 2000 he was working as Credit Manager in Doha Bank. He is in the habit of joining different employment. At the time of marriage, she was working in Air India and left it and settled with her husband in Oman. She was having dependent visa from 1987 to 2000. Whenever they used to come to India during vacations, they used to stay for 30 days. She has not complained to the Embassy about the harassment. Her mother came to Oman when her child was 1 years and she told about the harassment of her. Though he was harassing her from 1987 till 2000 she was residing with him. She admits that her uncles used to come to Oman and her husband had arranged visa. She admits that she was a housewife at Oman. She admits 8 Cr.A.25164/2014 that her mother is having 2 acres of land at Hennur road which was given to her as gift. She has shown ignorance that her husband had paid the amount towards purchase of that land. She has shown ignorance about the source of income of her mother towards purchase of that property. At the time of purchase, her father was not alive. He died in 1997. However, she denied that her husband had paid money towards purchase of that property. She admits that in 1999 her relatives came to Muscat and resided for two week and her husband had arranged visa for them. She admits that when they came to India they had purchased a house by paying Rs.90 lakhs at Hutchins Road wherein she is residing. She had stated that she also contributed towards purchase of that house. That property is in the joint name. They have borrowed loan of Rs.30 lakhs from Standard Chartered Bank. According to her the remaining Rs.60 lakhs was paid by the respondent by selling a flat which was purchased in 1991. Now that house is free from encumbrances. Both her daughters have 9 Cr.A.25164/2014 completed Law Degree. There are two floors in the house. She denied that the amount towards repayment of the loan was paid by her husband and she in turn discharged the loan. When that loan was borrowed, she was working in many companies. She has shown ignorance of showing payment of Rs.65,000/- towards loan instalment. According to her, in the year 2004-05 her monthly income was Rs.1- 1 lakhs. She has shown ignorance as to how much amount was paid towards purchase of property in Hennur road and she is not aware of the owner of that land. They came to India in the yeaer 2000. she admits about Ex.R.1 to R.15. She had not lodged complaint against the respondent till filing of this case. She admits that the respondent had paid the air ticket expenses of his daughter. From 2010 they are residing separately. She is residing in the first floor and respondent is residing in the ground floor. Shortly after her birth, Petitioner went to 10 Cr.A.25164/2014 Muscat to joint the respondent. Till the age of 8, she studied at Muscat. Her father due to ill-health, was unable to handle the work in Muscat and hence, they came back to India. Her mother used to work in several M.N.Cs. Her sister is studying in II year LL.B. She completed B.A.LL.B. Till they returned to Mr.Lloyd Joseph Sequeira vs Mrs.Louella Sequeira @ Louella on 13 June, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153314617/ 4 India, she had healthy relationship with her father. Always she look up to him to return home from work. When they came back to India, her father changed. He did not go to work and remained at home and used to be in angry mood. He used to shout on her elder sister. Her father frequently used to visit Pune to visit his family. They have shifted to a house outside the city and the bus pick-up point was around 3 kms. away from her house. Her father used to drop sometimes and her mother used to drop in a two wheeler. When she was 10 years old, fighting between the parents was worse and her father by catching one of the dogs was hanging it outside her bedroom window from the gazebo. She had stated about the incidents to show that her father was harassing her mother. Afterwards, her father's aunt came to live with 11 Cr.A.25164/2014 him and she caused several problems and she used to talk in Swahili all the time which they could not understand. After completing 10th standard, she was enjoying spending time with her friends. Her father was very angry and she became one of the targets. When she entered Law college in 2008 there was better position. Her sister had got scholarship to study in France. However, he told that he will not pay any expenses to her or ticket. In 2009 her father had completely moved all his things to one of the bedrooms in ground floor. By 2010 her mother and father used to live like virtual strangers. In July 2010 when she was on a trip to GRS park, her mother called and immediately she came and found that her mother was distraught and told about the fighting between them. He was staying in an empty flat of his friend behind their house. She had stated about the incidents which she had suffered due to their strained relationship. She had stated that when she was in need of internet router and when she went downstairs, at that time one Sean D'netto was visiting him who had earlier often harassed her to meet him even 12 Cr.A.25164/2014 though he was almost his parents' age. When she complained to the police, they did not take any action. She also stated that the counsel of her father had attacked her. Her father had made allegations about her mother having illicit connection. She also stated about filing of M.C.petition. She also stated about the incident occurred on the day of Christmas 2012. She also stated that she is unable to live peacefully from that day of incident. 11. During the course of cross-examination she admits that when her father was in Muscat her mother was not employed. When they came to India she was aged 8-9 years. She was aware that her father was not in a position to work in Muscat. They were working as consultants. She admits that she was trained to drive the vehicle at the age of 18. Whenever they came to India they used to go for trip. They have purchased the property at Hennur when they were in Dubai. She admits that the dispute was due to mistake of both parents. She admits that her father is a man of discipline. Though they attempted to pacify the dispute but it was of no use. Her father is not 13 Cr.A.25164/2014 accompanying them for food. Her mother never called her father to take food. Her mother never tried to talk with her father. In 2004, her father used to visit Puna to see his mother and sister. They shifted to new house in 2002. Her mother used to drop them to the school bus. She admits that her father used to bring them on many occasions. She admits that she sent mail by requesting to resolve the dispute. Her father took her mother to hospital due to ill- health. She has shown ignorance about the work of her father. She has shown ignorance that her father used to stay in the house. According to her, her grandmother had paid amount towards purchase of scooter and car. Her father and his brothers used to grow in Dungania of Africa. Whenever her elder aunt comes she used to speak in the language of Africa. As there was a dispute between her parents, her mother and herself went to grand-parents' house. Her mother attempted to visit her father. She denied that Mr.Lloyd Joseph Sequeira vs Mrs.Louella Sequeira @ Louella on 13 June, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153314617/ 5 her mother is responsible for the dispute. As her father used to send mails, her mother had changed the passport. Her father used to send abusive messages 14 Cr.A.25164/2014 through e-mail. She admits that her father was angry because of a boy by name Prashanth Saldanha. She admits that her father was not interested about this friendship. She admits that she used to go in the car. According to her she saw only one incident but her father used to abuse in filthy language. 12. To support the contention of the Petitioner, she examined PW.3 who is the eldest daughter who also stated on par with PW.2. 13. She was born in Bangalore. She stayed with her parents in Muscat till 2000. From 2010 her parents are living separately. Her mother worked from 2000-2010. She has shown ignorance that her father had kept deposits in the name of her mother. Her father used to take them to church every week in Muscat. He also took them to Alen, Dubai and Soha. She admits that her father is a systematic and disciplined man. She has shown ignorance about giving of roses and greeting cards to her mother by her father. They used to go to beach regularly. According to her, her father did not try to maintain good relationship 15 Cr.A.25164/2014 with the family. He alone is responsible for the strained relationship. Her mother always supported her father. Her mother met many councilors and priest to set right her dispute. Her father used to restrain them from moving with their friends till the age of 20. She is unable to convince her father. Though she tries to greet her father, he ignores her. She made attempts to know how her father is residing in the ground floor. 14. The same type of cross-examination is made to her also. She has stated that her father assaulted once to her mother in her presence. After 1 months the Petitioner joined him. There was a cordial marital life. They had two issues. He had taken care of the children as responsible parent. He alone was the earning member and he acquired number of properties at Bangalore and Puna. As the relationship was cordial between him and his wife some of the properties were 16 Cr.A.25164/2014 registered in the name of the Petitioner and her mother on the basis of trust. The funds were provided by him alone. In the year 2000 they decided to quit the job and settled down at Bangalore with the family. However, the Petitioner became very hostile towards him and also brain washed the children. The Petitioner made him penniless and now he is settled down in Pune at the mercy of others. He was always caring husband. When they were residing in Muscat, Petitioners family members used to visit frequently. The Petitioner never allowed his family members either in Muscat or in Bangalore. In the year 2010 the marital relationship became worse. He alleges that it is the Petitioner who treated him with cruelty. He had physical intimacy till April 2010 with the wife. The allegations made are false. 16. Their marriage was a registered marriage and thereafter it was religious marriage. He was posted as Credit Manager at Muscat. He denied that the Petitioner was working as Air hostess. She was employed as Air hostess in Air India prior to marriage. He had stated about 17 Cr.A.25164/2014 his salary and employment upto 2000. He was unable to work for 1 year from 2000. He was doing real estate and social work from his house. The property at Hennur is about 2 acres which is Mr.Lloyd Joseph Sequeira vs Mrs.Louella Sequeira @ Louella on 13 June, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153314617/ 6 standing in the name of his mother-in-law but the entire amount was paid by him. He is having property at Puna and house at HBR layout and the ancestral property at Goa. He kept Rs.20 lakhs in the name of his wife Citi Bank and Rs.7 lakhs in Canara Bank. She is in possession of the ancestral gold ornaments. He denied that Rs.27 lakhs was paid as advance to the property in Hennur. The amount is used to clear the loan of house property. The property at Hennur is in litigation and the advance amount paid by the purchaser is kept in bank. He did not pay the amount towards the education expense of his daughters since 8 years. He admits that his wife and children are managing the life by the interest amount of bank deposit. He denied the suggestions made with respect to the act of domestic violence as alleged in the petition. He denied that himself and his friend use to play music with loud sound. He admits that he is having 18 Cr.A.25164/2014 air gun. He admits that he used to collect the excreta of the dog and throw it in the portion of the drive way. The dog was not taken out for walk. According to him his wife left his house when his aunt came to stay with him. He denied that his sister was creating problems in the house. He denied that due to erectile dysfunction he was hostile towards his wife. He admits that his wife was consultant in Infosys and Bangalore Management Academy and Wipro. According to him his wife was suffering from epilepsy, OCD and going through middle of menopause. He never accompanied his wife to the Doctor. He resigned the job in 2000 on health grounds. His daughters are residing with his wife and she is maintaining with his money. She is getting interest from the deposits. He was suffering from severe blood pressure. He denied about the allegations about disconnection of cable connection, computer connection and caused trouble to his wife and children. He denied that he threatened his daughter to discontinue the membership in the library. He denied that he burnt the maths projects of his daughter. He left the house on 19 Cr.A.25164/2014 16.7.2010 and returned on 28.10.2010. He admits that himself and his wife have purchased many properties. He denied that by playing loud music, he troubled his wife and children. He denied that he used to throw garbage in the passage. He denied that he defamed his daughters through Face Book. Himself and his wife were not in good terms of conversation. He denied that the relatives came to settle the dispute. He admits that he used to arrange parties to his friends and he used to serve liquor. He admits that one Prashanth is a friend of his daughter and he used to attend parties. He objected for their friendship. According to him, Prashanth personally asked him for relationship with his daughter who was a student at that time. He denied that he used to call his daughter as prostitute. According to him on 20.6.2010 the committee of Goan Association made accusations against his wife about misappropriation of funds. 17. The documents relied upon by the Petitioner are Ex.P.1 NCR, Ex.P.2 copy of complaint given to the Inspector, Ex.P.3 is the copy of the order sheet in 20 Cr.A.25164/2014 Cr.No.386/2010, Ex.P.4 FIR and Ex.P.5 is the copy of the complaint. 18. Against these documents relied upon by the respondent are Ex.R.1 to R.20 are the greeting cards, Ex.R.21 and R.22 are the letters written by his daughters, Ex.R.23 to 25 are the photographs.
texts.arguments: 15. Against this, in the evidence of the respondent he had categorically stated that immediately after the marriage he went to Muscat to rejoin his employment.
